A1.justification: Both PDFs are readable versions of the same work, allowing reliable comparison of the method, equations, tables, and figures. Neither contains an appendix or embedded supplement. V2 references supplementary material that is not supplied; its promised contents cannot be assessed.

before.justification: V1 reports original reconstruction experiments on HOI4D and HO3D, quantitative comparisons in Tables 1–2, and ablation and initialization-noise results in Table 3.

after.justification: V2 retains the original HOI4D and HO3D experiments, quantitative comparisons, ablations, and qualitative reconstruction results.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the three deformation fields, interaction-aware Gaussian parameters, regularizations, and five-stage optimization. V2 newly mentions an auxiliary momentum loss through a supplementary-material pointer, but does not establish a procedural change.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate HOI4D and HO3D with the same translation and translation–rotation coverage. The reconstruction examples are retained; Figure 4's revised caption does not establish a new test scenario.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains 4DGS, Deform3DGS, and SC-GS. Table 2 retains those methods plus HOLD and BIGS, including the foreground-only BIGS comparison. Newly cited related works are not added as evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: The scene selections, HO3D camera 4, alternate-frame and full-frame evaluations, foreground-only comparison, resolutions, and PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS metrics remain unchanged. Both report 21,000 training iterations; v2's GPU memory specification is additional disclosure.

E4.justification: Section 4.3 retains the same component-removal ablations and initialization-noise tests at sigma 0.01 and 0.05. Figures 4–6 retain the novel-view, noise-robustness, and component-rendering examples. No additional analysis is included.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The red table annotations remain differences from the reference method, not uncertainty estimates.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–3 are unchanged, including full-frame, foreground-only, ablation, and noise results. The figures retain the same qualitative reconstruction examples and comparative findings; Figure 4's broader wording supplies no new result.

T1.justification: Equations 1–13 retain the same mathematical definitions and formulations, including the rotation regularizer, interaction distance, neighborhood weights, and deformation blend. No theorem, proof, or substantive derivation is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: reconstruction without object priors, interaction-aware Gaussians, hand-conditioned object deformation, progressive optimization, and superior benchmark performance. Shortened contribution bullets preserve their meaning.

C2.justification: Section 2 newly makes rigid-object applicability and independence from external generative models explicit. Figure 4 replaces the qualification 'within the egocentric viewing cone' with 'extrapolated' viewpoints having 'considerable change,' despite unchanged images. The rapid-motion and complex-trajectory limitations remain.

D1.justification: V2 adds a project-page address and specifies a single RTX 3090 with 24G memory. It also newly names a momentum loss and points to supplementary implementation details. The supplement is absent, so those details and resource availability cannot be verified.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds eight works: DyTact, HARP, MANUS, G-HOP, diffusion-guided HOI reconstruction by Ye et al., MagicHOI, BimArt, and SyncDiff. Short new discussions distinguish the work from personalized hand models, diffusion-guided reconstruction, and articulated-interaction synthesis while retaining its existing positioning.

P1.justification: V2 shortens contribution bullets, edits several explanatory passages, expands related-work prose, updates affiliations, and adds acknowledgements and supplementary pointers. The section sequence and most substantive prose remain intact.

P2.justification: The entire document changes from a two-column layout to a single-column proceedings format, substantially altering typography, headers, and figure/table sizes and placements. All six figures and three tables are retained; Figure 4's caption is revised.

improvement.justification: The expanded related-work discussion and explicit rigid-object scope make the contribution easier to assess, while the project-page pointer and hardware clarification add modest practical value. The scientific method and empirical evidence remain unchanged. The absent referenced supplement and Figure 4's broader wording without new evidence limit these gains.
